note: Generic demo size charts for the KamerWear school MVP. They follow common unisex ready-to-wear ranges and are not any brand's official chart. Body measurements in centimetres; a size covers [min, max).

bottoms.measurement: waist_cm and hip_cm (the larger size wins)

shoes.measurement: entered by the customer (never estimated from photos)

fit_preference.note: Slim moves one size down when the measurement is in the lowest quarter of its size range; Relaxed moves one size up when it is in the highest quarter. Regular keeps the best match.
